# PRFlow Review — PR #2014 (iteration 1)

**Verdict: APPROVE**

## Change under review
A CI-shard rebalance in `lib/test/run-shard.sh` `_shard_modules`: four module-id tokens (`installer-wiring`, `parallel-suite-runner`, `tier1-rename-migration`, `experiment-records`) moved from the `modules-rest` shard-group string into the `modules-large` shard-group string. Single file, 15 diff lines. No shard added or removed; the union of module groups is unchanged.

## Diff classification (Phase 0.5)
small_diff=true, config_only=false, has_new_types=false, engine_self_modifying=true (path under `lib/**`), detect_all_audit=false. Profile: engine_self_modifying overrides the checklist behavior -> full Phase 1+2 checklist ran (checklist_skipped=null). Phase 3 roster gated normally; type-design-analyzer skipped (has_new_types false); pr-test-analyzer dispatched (changed path matches `*test*`).

## Checklist (Phase 1/1.5/2)
7 items generated, deduped to 7 distinct, all VERIFIED PASS against the working tree:
- Union of all module groups == registered `test_modules` set (20 == 20). PASS
- No module duplicated across groups (raw emission count 20 == registry size 20; uniq -d empty). PASS
- Exactly the four named tokens moved; present in modules-large, absent from modules-rest. PASS
- SHARD_NAMES unchanged (monolith python-pool modules-pin modules-large modules-rest). PASS
- ci.yml shard matrix references shard NAMES only (unchanged) -> no edit required, coupled-order invariant intact. PASS
- Four moved tokens are valid registered modules (no extras vs registry). PASS
- Coverage comment (lines 23-25 / 43-45 'union == registered module set, no module dropped') remains accurate. PASS

Independent Phase 2 verification executed: union==registry True, duplicates [], dropped [], extra [], moved-in-large True, moved-absent-from-rest True.

## Phase 3 review agents
Dispatched 5 (roster complete for this profile): code-reviewer (model opus), silent-failure-hunter, comment-analyzer, pr-test-analyzer, requesting-code-review (final pass). type-design-analyzer excluded by has_new_types gate. All returned; 0 failed. Every agent found the change a pure partition-preserving rebalance with no defect. The final-pass reviewer returned APPROVE. No findings at any severity.

Extension load (final pass): EXTENSION-STATUS loaded-empty, resolved-root=unset — a success token; no notice owed.

## Verdict rationale
No Critical, Important, or Suggestion findings from any agent; all checklist items verified PASS; the correctness invariant that gates this change (union of shard module groups == registry, no duplicate, no drop) holds and is covered by existing dynamically-derived assertions in `lib/test/run.sh` (#877 block, lines ~49556-49572) and `lib/test/modules/parallel-suite-runner.sh`. APPROVE.
